# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 17
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 17

---

*[Final commission. The cloud departs. The closing of the vision.]*

1. And while he was yet speaking, he was taken up into the heavens, and a great cloud of light received him, and we saw written on that cloud: "This is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased; he has kept my commandments."

2. And we remained there weeping and sorrowful, because we could not see him any more.

3. And Moses and Elijah, who also had gone up with him into the heavens, heard the voice of God saying to them: "You shall go to my holy mountain and remain there until the day of my coming, which is to be completed in the generation which is yet to come."

4. And we fell upon our faces and praised God and the Lord. And we saw the cloud draw away from us and go up into heaven.

5. And Moses and Elijah came down again from the holy mountain, weeping and lamenting, and they said to us: "He has gone up. He has left us."

6. And we fell upon our faces again and wept, because our Lord had gone away from us.

7. But the Lord Jesus Christ was taken from our midst and he went up to heaven. And a voice out of heaven said: "This is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased."

8. And many were gathered together in his name, and they were proclaimed righteous in his name and were sanctified and their sins were forgiven them.

9. And our Lord Jesus Christ said to us before he departed: "I give you power over serpents and over scorpions and over the power of the enemy, and over all manner of disease, that whatever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven."

10. And he said to us further: "Go and teach all the nations and baptize them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit."

11. "And let it be known to you — as I said before — that the prophets have spoken concerning the things that I have shown to you."

12. And we praised God and glorified him and went on our way and proclaimed the kingdom of heaven everywhere in his name, and preached repentance and forgiveness of sins in all the world.

---
*EMET note: The closing verses (vv.9–12) contain near-verbatim citations from the canonical Gospels (Matt 10:1, Matt 28:18–20, Luke 24:47). The APE ends by embedding itself within the canonical missionary tradition, claiming apostolic authorization for its content.*
